_comment: Maps OUR catalog SKUs to Printful catalog variants. Fill this in once the Printful account's products are chosen: for each SKU+size, look up the matching blank in the Printful catalog (GET /v2/catalog-products, then /catalog-variants) and record its catalog_variant_id. print_file_url must be a PUBLICLY reachable URL of the print-ready artwork (Printful fetches it). Apparel entries are keyed 'SKU:SIZE'; non-sized goods keyed by SKU alone. SKUs with no entry here cannot be fulfilled and are blocked at checkout with a clear error.
